theme: Loss-aversion - Yatra-week travellers are searching Kashmir stays and booking days ahead; unlisted rooms lose the guest to the hotel down the road
season: Mid-summer (18 July 2026). The Amarnath Yatra is on (3 Jul - 28 Aug), so the Srinagar-Pahalgam and Srinagar-Sonamarg roads run in convoys and hotels fill fast - book 3-4 weeks ahead and travel within the valley in daylight. Srinagar wakes cool at dawn and warms by day while the plains sit above 40C; gardens are at peak bloom, the meadows are deep green, the Dal is glass at first light. Fast-changing weather with sunny mornings, cool evenings and brief afternoon showers, with flash-flood watches on the higher Yatra routes.
subject: Peak Yatra weeks are here and your rooms stay hidden
